goal: Allow external indexers and applications to read block and header data while Bitcoin Core is running
Remove exclusive database locks that force users to shut down their node for index inspection
reviewability: Author has been silent for 70 days, so reviews may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Strong conceptual support for replacing LevelDB block index storage (josibake, theuni, ismaelsadeeq, w0xlt)
Nonblocking objection: directory commits are no-ops on Windows, risking inconsistency on power loss (stickies-v)
Nonblocking objection: read-only readers could observe stale or partial data after writer crashes (willcl-ark)
Differential fuzzing against LevelDB showed no issues across 5,000 CPU hours (marcofleon)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it allows external kernel consumers to inspect block data without stopping the node
Unblocks concurrent index building for external tools like Electrs and Esplora

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because replacing block index storage directly impacts crash recovery and chainstate integrity
Major architectural overhaul to mandatory block storage persistence
